notes.title: The Commando Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wvtv868.png[/img]
Meet the newest addition to the roster of playable characters, the Commando!

In addition to a Bowie knife and a missile launcher, the commando can pick up cans of tactical face paint to briefly guarantee critical hits!

This update includes a host of other improvements and additions:

[list]
[*] Visual uplift for all characters
[*] New, unique mechanics for all characters
[*] New items and status effects
[*] Active items have been totally reworked
[*] New types of levels and special events to find
[/list]

I hope you enjoy!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XTRRf7v.png[/img]

notes.title: New Monsters and the Monster Gallery
notes.notes:
[h1]New Monsters![/h1]

I've continued to add new monsters to the final world, and continue to tune and rework existing monsters. I've also added a monster gallery, where you can view the monsters in the worlds you have discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/ebea69521c2344ae498156c66be2135fb1304aff.png[/img]

notes.title: The Status Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Items![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/9b2fa660b194ee36ac66aa3d46d5ea8c34f1743c.png[/img]

This update adds four new items: The Magnifying Glass, Black Pearl, Pocketknife, and Matchbook. These correspond to the four new status effects that have been added: Focus, Curse, Scratch, and Burn. These status effects can be applied to any of your abilities, and provide some new ways to tailor your builds.

A new item unlocks system has been added, so you will see these items become available after some time playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/fee1fa7fc842d7d3a83cf6b56be38527544171b3.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet the Scientist and the Baseball Player
notes.notes:
[h1]New Characters![/h1]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/5ea108180306023f569ffe7bbc78aef4bb8005ec.png[/img]

Two new characters are available to unlock: the Scientist and the Baseball Player. The Scientist carries a laser pointer and a boiling flask with toxic fumes, and the baseball player makes good use of his bat and ball.

[h1]New Foes![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/2799b4a4c9557e1fabd00ab13fe78ace2c146c6c.png[/img]

All worlds feature new or reworked enemies, with new attacks and visual uplift to certain attacks to make them read more clearly. Combat pace has also been tuned to accommodate for the fact that all characters have had their starting dash charges reduced by 1. (Dash cooldown has been reduced as a result) These changes together will hopefully make combat feel a little more deliberate, and a little less chaotic.

notes.title: New Enemies
notes.notes:
[h1]New Enemies[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/75d336e8363c74717a6f8ec0e1f6ecb1378cb380.png[/img]

The final world, Insidious Interior, features five new enemy types, and reworks to some existing enemy attacks. Since this world is part of every successful run, it felt underserved in enemy variety. This should go some way to address that issue.

notes.title: Meet the Martian
notes.notes:
[h1]The Martian[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/fd494ad4395b6ca6e11ecaa245e4d6161aa86866.png[/img]

The Martian is a new character focused on high speed, low friction movement. Deceleration is no longer automatic, so you can float around the arena with controls that feel very different from other characters.


[h1]Level Events[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/0608d9c22ab4155f6d62671bdcb9e1665f87d39f.png[/img]

New level events have replaced the previous "Environmental Attacks." Some events, like "Lucky Day," will give you a specific stat or resource boost, but many of them will offer a unique challenge or additional element that you will need to alter your play in order to overcome. There are 13 room events to discover, and on higher difficulty levels you might see them combined to form some truly devious levels.

[h1]UI Rework[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820442/4eb85de1694298b723aaf5ea7431b7f9c64f8657.png[/img]

The interface has been reworked to show cooldown icons for your active items.
